result.title: Stochastic Tracking of Drifting Affine Fixed Points
result.summary: Linear stochastic approximation (SA) is widely used to estimate fixed points from noisy observations, but most finite-time analyses assume that the underlying operator remains fixed. We study linear SA with time-varying affine operators, where the fixed points change over time and the observation noise may be correlated across rounds. For constant-stepsize updates, we establish a bound on the cumulative expected squared distance between the iterates and the corresponding fixed points. The bound accounts for the initial error, observation noise, and changes in the fixed points over time. We also establish lower bounds for scalar Gaussian models, showing that, under specified conditions, a suitably chosen constant stepsize achieves the smallest possible worst-case cumulative error up to constant factors, even compared with estimators that use future observations. These results further quantify the effect of temporal correlation on estimation accuracy. Since choosing an appropriate stepsize generally requires knowledge of the noise level and how much the fixed points change, we develop an adaptive method that uses an additional bounded, unbiased observation of the fixed point to achieve an almost optimal algorithm without needing the knowledge of the noise level and the fixed point variation over time. Finally, we apply our results to value-function estimation using synchronous tabular temporal-difference learning in changing environments, assuming generative-model access and a common invariant distribution.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究固定点随时间漂移的线性随机逼近：在常数步长下给出迭代点与对应固定点累积平方误差的上界与下界，并设计仅依赖一个有界无偏观测、无需预知噪声水平与漂移幅度的自适应步长方法，最后应用于变化环境下的表格 TD 值函数估计。
AI.relevance_reason: 若把 latent 推理的循环/迭代状态更新视为向某个（可能随深度或上下文漂移的）目标表示的随机逼近，其噪声—漂移权衡与无需先验噪声知识即可自适应选步长的结论，可能为动态计算分配与停止决策提供概念线索，具体对应关系仍需核查。
